extraction_method_note: Manually authored by reading erc-20.raw.md section by section, same discipline as ERC-4626's clauses.json. This standard is registered specifically to prove rtf/standards/discovery.py and generator.py are genuinely generic across standard families (see metadata.json's registered_reason), not to be an exhaustively complete ERC-20 translation.
excluded_as_non_normative_note: totalSupply(), balanceOf(), and allowance() carry NO RFC2119 keyword anywhere in EIP-20's actual specification text -- their descriptions are bare declarative sentences ('Returns the total token supply.', etc.) with no MUST/SHOULD/MAY governing them, unlike almost every ERC-4626 method. No clause was invented for them; this is the correct behavior for a source-driven translation, not a gap. The approve() method's 'clients SHOULD make sure to create user interfaces...' guidance was also excluded: it is advisory language directed at wallet/client UX, not an obligation on the Tested Code (the on-chain contract) itself -- 'the contract itself shouldn't enforce it' is stated explicitly in the same paragraph.

clauses.normalized_obligation: Callers of transfer/transferFrom/approve MUST handle a `false` returned from `returns (bool success)` rather than assuming success.
Callers MUST NOT assume that `false` is never returned by transfer/transferFrom/approve.

provenance.quoted_text: Callers MUST NOT assume that `false` is never returned!

clauses.normalized_obligation: Interfaces and other contracts MUST NOT expect name() to be present (it is an OPTIONAL method).

provenance.quoted_text: OPTIONAL - This method can be used to improve usability, but interfaces and other contracts MUST NOT expect these values to be present.

provenance.quoted_text: OPTIONAL - This method can be used to improve usability, but interfaces and other contracts MUST NOT expect these values to be present.

clauses.normalized_obligation: transfer() MUST fire the Transfer event.

provenance.quoted_text: Transfers `_value` amount of tokens to address `_to`, and MUST fire the `Transfer` event.

clauses.normalized_obligation: transfer() SHOULD throw if the caller's account balance does not have enough tokens to spend.
conditions: the message caller's account balance does not have enough tokens to spend

provenance.quoted_text: The function SHOULD `throw` if the message caller's account balance does not have enough tokens to spend.

clauses.normalized_obligation: transfer() of a zero value MUST be treated as a normal transfer and MUST fire the Transfer event.

provenance.quoted_text: Transfers of 0 values MUST be treated as normal transfers and fire the `Transfer` event.

clauses.normalized_obligation: transferFrom() MUST fire the Transfer event.

provenance.quoted_text: Transfers `_value` amount of tokens from address `_from` to address `_to`, and MUST fire the `Transfer` event.

clauses.normalized_obligation: transferFrom() SHOULD throw unless the _from account has deliberately authorized the sender of the message.
conditions: the _from account has not deliberately authorized the message sender

provenance.quoted_text: The function SHOULD `throw` unless the `_from` account has deliberately authorized the sender of the message via some mechanism.

clauses.normalized_obligation: transferFrom() of a zero value MUST be treated as a normal transfer and MUST fire the Transfer event.

provenance.quoted_text: Transfers of 0 values MUST be treated as normal transfers and fire the `Transfer` event.

clauses.normalized_obligation: The Transfer event MUST trigger when tokens are transferred, including zero-value transfers.

provenance.quoted_text: MUST trigger when tokens are transferred, including zero value transfers.

clauses.normalized_obligation: A token contract that creates new tokens SHOULD trigger a Transfer event with _from set to 0x0 when tokens are created.

provenance.quoted_text: A token contract which creates new tokens SHOULD trigger a Transfer event with the `_from` address set to `0x0` when tokens are created.

clauses.normalized_obligation: The Approval event MUST trigger on any successful call to approve().

provenance.quoted_text: MUST trigger on any successful call to `approve(address _spender, uint256 _value)`.
